result.summary: Extended the SDK with atomic scoped parent/child delegation and ancestor cancellation admission checks. Completed inference replay and admitted-effect reconciliation retain their existing behavior. The production source adds no Contract or Runtime dependency. All 15 focused delegation tests, 23 adapted lifecycle tests, and 9 existing evaluation tests pass.

changes.description: Full revised SDK source. create_task(spec, *, parent=None) verifies parent freshness, restricts child inputs, publication targets and output size, and transfers request credits in the same transaction as child creation. Fresh admission traverses ancestor cancellation state; historical root records lacking a parent field remain compatible. Replay and reconciliation paths are unchanged.

Fifteen focused tests cover budget transfer and allocation/spending races, transactional rollback, scope restrictions, stale parent inputs and profile ABA, multilevel cancellation, replay, effect reconciliation, blocked retries, sibling independence, legacy roots, and dependency isolation.
